material_units.source_text: (a) $L_{11}=1$, $L_{21}=2$, $L_{31}=0$, $L_{22}=\sqrt{5-4}=1$, $L_{32}=2$, $L_{33}^2=a-4$: PD iff $a\gt4$. (b) Leading minors $1$, $1$, $\det P(a)=(5a-4)-4a=a-4$. (c) At $a=4$ the last pivot is $0$ and $P(4)=LL^\top$ (with $L_{33}=0$) is a Gram form: PSD but singular, with null vector $(4,-2,1)$ from $L^\top x=0$. (d) With $L=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 & 0\\ 2 & 1 & 0\\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{bmatrix}$: forward $y=(1,2,1)$, backward $x=(1,0,1)$; check $P(5)x=(1,4,5)$. $\log\det P(5)=2\sum\log L_{jj}=0$, i.e. $\det=1=a-4$.
